title: CFA lane 4: equity valuation (dividends, cash flows, multiples)
mission: Curate atomic, reusable equity-valuation relationships: multi-stage dividend discount, free-cash-flow and residual-income forms, and multiple-based valuation arithmetic, each with explicit growth, timing and required-return conventions. Valuation arithmetic only; continue through successive batches with no stock-picking chain required.
priorities: Single-period and multi-stage dividend discount present values with explicit stage timing
Free cash flow to firm (FCFF) and to equity (FCFE) build-up identities from stated components
FCFF/FCFE present values with constant-growth terminal value and the growth-below-rate guard explicit
Residual income valuation from book value and abnormal earnings with stated clean-surplus scope
Trailing and justified P/E, P/B, P/S and EV/EBITDA multiple arithmetic with stated earnings basis
PEG and dividend-yield arithmetic with stated growth and payout scope
Sustainable growth decomposition supporting growth inputs, distinct from lane-2 ROE records by reference
Required-return build-ups used in equity models (equity risk premium forms) with stated components
boundaries: This lane owns equity-valuation arithmetic; statement ratios, capital budgeting, fixed income, derivatives and portfolio records belong to lanes 1-3, 5 and 6.

Do not resubmit the 14 covered TVM-family IDs as new coverage — including constant-growth-stock-present-value; multi-stage and FCFF/FCFE forms are distinct records with their own sources and overlap notes.
Trailing vs forward vs annualized inputs are part of the record (meaning, context, guards), never silent choices.
Exclude price forecasts, buy/sell recommendations and analyst-judgment adjustments.
Terminal-value forms state their steady-state assumptions; no infinite-horizon hand-waving beyond the guarded formula.
starter_sources: Owner excerpt packet for this lane (discovery leads with exact PDF locators; corroborate every record against a directly inspected accessible source).
A public investments text with the same valuation forms (for example OpenStax Principles of Finance); record exact book, edition and section, never cite a root URL as evidence.
special_checks: Growth-below-required-return guards are explicit on every Gordon-type and terminal-value record, with rejection cases.
Independently sum stage cash flows for multi-stage references instead of repeating the closed form.
Clean-surplus and steady-state assumptions are stated as assumptions with scope, not buried in prose.
Test a zero-growth and a zero-dividend boundary explicitly.
integration_expectation: New meanings (free_cash_flow_firm, residual_income, price_earnings_multiple and similar) require extension; multi-stage sums fit the engine via sum over index families once meanings exist. Currency amounts never convert implicitly. Never relabel equity value as an operating cost or a multiple as a discount rate to force execution.
coverage_guidance: Priorities are seeds, not a finite checklist. Continue into adjacent equity readings inside the boundaries, selecting independently reusable relationships. Save multiple bounded batches without waiting for owner review. Check supplied inventory and prior returns for equivalent relationships and conflicting IDs. Record out-of-format discoveries as deferred with exact sources and missing capabilities; do not force chains or dilute quality for a quota.
